author: National Geographic
description:
On April 15, 1912, the mighty Titanic collided with an iceberg and sank, becoming one of the most infamous shipwrecks in history. In Titanic Sinks Tonight, historians break down minute by minute the night the unsinkable ship sank, exploring vivid firsthand accounts from passengers and crew to tell the story of the infamous maritime disaster. 

In this first full episode from National Geographic, the Titanic collides with an iceberg and as news of the damage filters through to captain Edward John Smith, he realizes his “unsinkable ship” is going down.
